family: eight fixed labelled five-bit phase tables, paired cyclically; exact initial spectrum references; two private point blocks and fair mux

domain.prefix: shared0; reset both; private A or B or z selected by pair index mod3; shared0; reset both; shared0; reset both; shared0 then stop

arithmetic: integer FWHT, Fraction, prime-log vectors and32-term rational atanh bounds; exact integer fallback
scalars: all256 three-bit Boolean phases with exact and uniform inherited refs, plus eight five-bit phases; dummy padding of eight phases by two bits
lane_partition: history index parity, eight full histories/lane
scope: conditional all-dimension proof is analytic; finite histories are evidence, not full FEI
